reasoning_traces.think:
The core insight is that monorepo structure enforces architectural discipline through typed contracts, ensuring modules share interfaces without breaking dependencies. This mirrors GSI’s use of `@sports/types` to maintain consistency. Multi-tenancy introduces a dual challenge: enforcing tenant boundaries at runtime and ensuring all queries are scoped. Manual propagation via `RequestContext` creates a fragile dependency—any missed `tenantId` leads to data leakage. The inheritance hierarchy provides a clean abstraction for tenant-scoped entities, but lacks automatic enforcement mechanisms. These primitives form a dual system: one for compile-time contract validation and another for runtime safety checks. Failure modes arise when either layer fails—either due to missing type contracts or unscoped queries. The system thus balances correctness with operational overhead.
